shortBio.en: The Kinks songwriter/vocals pillar; British social vignette and power-chord You Really Got Me origin.
shortBio.zh: The Kinks 写手/人声支柱；英国社会速写与 You Really Got Me 的 power-chord 源头。

whyHub.en: Primary writer across Kinks decades: riff singles and village-green narrative from one chair.
whyHub.zh: 跨 Kinks 数十年的主笔：riff 单曲与乡村绿地叙事出自同一席位。

body.en:
Born 1944, London. Forms The Kinks with brother Dave. You Really Got Me (1964) cites Dave’s sliced amp distortion and Ray’s hook writing—proto hard-rock riff on UK charts. Mid-late 60s shift to character songs (Waterloo Sunset, Village Green).

Hub: songwriter continuity through lineup and US-ban eras; Dave’s lead guitar is the other half of the sound, Ray owns the catalog spine.
body.zh:
1944 年生于伦敦。与弟 Dave 组建 The Kinks。You Really Got Me（1964）引用 Dave 的划破音箱失真与 Ray 的钩子写作——英国榜上的原硬摇滚 riff。60 年代中后期转向人物歌（Waterloo Sunset、Village Green）。

枢纽：跨阵容与赴美禁令年代的写手连续；Dave 主音吉他是声音另一半，Ray 拥有目录脊梁。

note.en: Founding songwriter/vocals through classic and later Kinks eras.
note.zh: 创始写手/人声，贯穿经典与后期 Kinks。

note.en: Solo and theatre-adjacent writing outside full Kinks activity.
note.zh: Kinks 全建制活动之外的独唱与剧场向写作。
